shared_rules: Do not place neighborhood image inside the hero.
Keep existing compact map hero pattern.
Use images only when they reinforce commercial identity.
Avoid generic skyline, residential-only, scenic, or atmospheric images.
Map heroes are orientation aids, not precise boundary maps.

map_hero_brief.title: Downtown Oakland
map_hero_brief.subtitle: East Bay institutional business core with BART, civic, and professional office context.
map_hero_brief.caution: Avoid showing Downtown Oakland as a broad all-Oakland geography.

image_brief.alt_text: Downtown Oakland commercial streetscape in Oakland, CA
image_brief.desired_subject: Broadway, City Center, or civic-core office streetscape with visible commercial buildings.

map_hero_brief.title: Uptown Oakland
map_hero_brief.subtitle: Mixed-use Oakland office district with Broadway, Lake Merritt, arts, food, and BART context.
map_hero_brief.primary_focus: Broadway / Franklin / Webster / Lake Merritt edge
map_hero_brief.caution: Differentiate from Downtown Oakland; do not make the map read as a duplicate CBD view.

image_brief.alt_text: Uptown Oakland commercial streetscape in Oakland, CA
image_brief.desired_subject: Broadway or Uptown mixed-use commercial blocks with office, storefront, and street activity.

map_hero_brief.title: Downtown Palo Alto
map_hero_brief.subtitle: Walkable Peninsula downtown with startup, professional office, retail, and Caltrain context.
map_hero_brief.primary_focus: University Avenue / Hamilton Avenue / Lytton Avenue
map_hero_brief.caution: Keep Stanford Research Park and California Avenue as comparison/context, not part of the core district.

image_brief.alt_text: Downtown Palo Alto commercial streetscape in Palo Alto, CA
image_brief.desired_subject: University Avenue, Hamilton Avenue, or Lytton Avenue low-rise office and retail streetscape.

map_hero_brief.title: South San Francisco Biotech Corridor
map_hero_brief.subtitle: Life science, R&D, flex, and industrial-support corridor near Oyster Point, Gateway, 101, and the airport.
map_hero_brief.primary_focus: Oyster Point / Gateway / Lindenville / Airport Blvd
map_hero_brief.caution: The map should read as corridor/ecosystem geography, not generic South San Francisco.

image_brief.alt_text: South San Francisco Biotech Corridor commercial streetscape in South San Francisco, CA
image_brief.desired_subject: Oyster Point, Gateway, or 101-adjacent life science/flex campus context.

map_hero_brief.title: Jack London Square
map_hero_brief.subtitle: Waterfront Oakland commercial district with office, retail, warehouse-adjacent, and service-commercial texture.
map_hero_brief.primary_focus: Franklin / Washington / 2nd and 3rd Streets / waterfront edge
map_hero_brief.caution: Do not frame as generic downtown office; preserve waterfront and service-commercial context.

image_brief.alt_text: Jack London Square commercial streetscape in Oakland, CA
image_brief.desired_subject: Waterfront commercial buildings, warehouse-adjacent streets, or office/retail near Jack London Square.
